verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an official hosted MCP server that any AI client can connect to with a single command, and first-party plugins that give Claude Code, Cursor and Codex memory. That covers the core of plugging off-the-shelf assistants into Mem0. However, ChatGPT is never named, and the docs never explicitly show several tools sharing one user's memory pool. missing for 10: explicit ChatGPT (and Claude desktop/chat app) support, documentation showing multiple assistants reading and writing the same user-scoped memory, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-tool sharing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect off-the-shelf assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to the same memory so every tool I use shares what it knows about me

citations.quote: Connect any AI client to Mem0 using Model Context Protocol in minutes
Plugins that let Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other harnesses remember your project.
Point your clients at the hosted server with a single command
The Mem0 MCP server hands your agent a set of memory tools, so it can decide for itself when to save something, look something up, or update what it already knows.
